diagnostics.message: :resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_iam_role.ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references

:resource.aws_eks_node_group.ng: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_iam_role.ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references
aws_autoscaling_group.ng already depends on aws_launch_template.ng through its launch template ID and version references.
aws_autoscaling_group.ng already depends transitively on aws_iam_role.ng through the launch template and instance profile (and through its policy attachments).
aws_eks_node_group.ng already references aws_iam_role.ng in node_role_arn, making the explicit role dependency redundant.
kubernetes_config_map.aws-auth already depends on aws_eks_cluster.cp transitively through its explicit aws_autoscaling_group.ng dependency and that group's cluster references.
time_sleep.wait already depends on aws_eks_cluster.cp through the node groups and kubernetes_config_map.aws-auth.
time_sleep.wait already depends on aws_autoscaling_group.ng through kubernetes_config_map.aws-auth's explicit dependency.

helm_release.albingress references only the IRSA role ARN; it can start the controller before aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.irsa grants its AWS permissions. Order the release after the attachment, for example by adding depends_on to the IRSA ARN output or depending on the whole irsa module.

helm_release.appmesh references only the IRSA role ARN and can start the controller before aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.irsa grants its required AWS permissions. Make the IRSA ARN output depend on its attachments or depend on the whole irsa module.

helm_release.autoscaler can start before aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.irsa grants autoscaling permissions: referencing the role ARN does not wait for its policy attachments. Make the IRSA ARN output depend on attachments or depend on the whole irsa module.

helm_release.containerinsights can start agents before aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.irsa grants logging permissions; the role ARN reference alone does not order policy attachment. Make the IRSA ARN output depend on attachments or depend on the whole irsa module.
